description: A blue bowl sits on the counter with small items nearby: two dark cherries, a small white-lidded container, a green block, a yellow duck, and a long yellow food-shaped piece. The left hand stays resting near the bowl while the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the long yellow piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and swings it leftward, then lowers it into the blue bowl and releases it so it rests inside.
